content.comment_body: If anyone has insight, please help. My [product_name] software does not show the Realtek network card as a selectable option. Currently, only the Quadcom Wireless card for Wi-Fi appears. My [product_name] device is connected via Ethernet and should be using the Realtek network card, but the connection consistently fails. I reinstalled [product_name] and the Realtek drivers, but the issue remains. My software version is [version_no]. Device details: [product_name] [version_no], [article_no], running on a Dell Inspiron 3000 laptop with Windows 10. Appreciate any suggestions as I've spent three days troubleshooting without success.
You have asked this in another topic: [document]. Why create a new one? I responded with some questions there, but you have not replied.
Apologies, I was confused and thought I lost my previous post. I'll try to locate it.
Please do not return to the previous topic, to avoid confusion. Stay here and continue the discussion. Can you provide a screenshot of your network adapters from the device manager?

Here are the IP details for my laptop and [product_name] setup: Laptop IP 192.168.0.3, Mask 255.255.255.0, Gateway 192.168.1.1. Software IP 192.168.0.2, Mask 255.255.255.0, Gateway 192.168.1.1. Device IP 192.168.0.1, Mask 255.255.255.0, Gateway 192.168.1.1.

Your [product_name] with order number [article_no] is the latest [version_no]. For this device, you need [product_name] version [version_no]. You can download the upgrade to the newest release. Reference: [document].
Thank you for your help. I suppose I need to wait for authorization before downloading, but I will follow your advice once I have access.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing an issue where their PC cannot establish communication with a [product_name] device over Ethernet due to the Realtek network card not being detected in the [product_name] software. Despite reinstalling drivers and software, the connectivity problem persists. Other participants clarify that the device requires an upgraded software version ([version_no]) for compatibility. This highlights the challenges users face with software versioning and hardware interface configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] software to recognize and allow selection of the Realtek Ethernet card for direct wired connection to the [product_name] device, enabling straightforward setup and reliable communication.
